claims.summary: For one already fixed full labelled source-target relation, every omitted target dummy role has a corresponding unselected source boundary. Since source supports already contain all source sinks, that corresponding source boundary lies on a directed source segment. Sequential insertion preserving prior segment order therefore enumerates the actual prefix word.

Selected marginal containment does not imply containment after restoring a hidden target coordinate and choosing a source placement. The exact algebraic counterexample is counterexamples/unconditional_lift_failure.json.

If a fixed full relation has fewer unselected source boundaries than restored target dummy roles, the compared full factors do not have the same boundary set. The branch is vacuous for fixed-full containment, not a separated mathematical case.
The completion grammar creates exactly three dummy role families that matter for core restoration: D_REPAIR, D_SINK, and marginalized INCOMING.
The rigid source support grammar labels every core path sink as Q_SINK before any extras are added; extras are generated only by segment assignments.

For each fixed prefix probe, the physical-to-effective descriptor map is a product over disjoint complete switching-mask row classes, with full-rank differential on the open cube. This is a mathematical lemma, not compiler-output evidence.

The compiler sorts target dummy labels by natural order and restores remaining[0] at every recursive step. The order is deterministic and any fixed order is exhaustive because all later labels are inserted into all positions relative to earlier labels.

Finite-union dimension logic can select one target presentation containing a source-open subgerm, but the compiler artifacts do not record a full-relation binding object or prove that the whole focal germ stays in one member. Only the subgerm version is defensible.
A source-only invariant bit means the target has an identity whose source pullback is not the zero polynomial, excluding full-dimensional source containment.
A target-only invariant with zero source pullback and strictly signed target pullback separates the open stochastic images in the required direction.
The same-sign power-coefficient test is sound but only sufficient. Terminal mixed-sign candidates need the factor/Bernstein pass or must remain unresolved.
At the terminal fully restored prefix, equality of labelled t_quotient codes is sufficient for the theorem's topological conclusion modulo ordinary triangle redirection.
Ordinary T is an allowed topological quotient, not a proof that the full stochastic JC images are identical.

The recursion itself preserves coherent source words along each root-to-leaf restoration path, but the emitted records deduplicate by canonical state and do not carry an explicit parent/full-relation identifier binding all prefixes and separate support-plus-one/two probes.
